curriculum_video_overview.topics_covered: National Education Policy 2020 alignment, multidisciplinary learning approach bridging history, geography, civics, and economics, governance, democracy, ancient empires, holistic development, and 21st-century skills.

image_asset.title: Soil Profiles & Cropping Seasons in India

hotspots.label: Alluvial Soil Zone
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Gangetic plains & river deltas; highly fertile for rice, wheat, and sugarcane.

hotspots.label: Black Soil (Regur) Zone
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Volcanic basalt origin in Deccan Trap; high moisture retention ideal for cotton and jowar.

hotspots.label: Kharif & Rabi Cropping Seasons
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Kharif coincides with South-West monsoon (June-Oct); Rabi is the winter season (Oct-April).

video_overview.title: Story of Indian Farming
video_overview.topics_covered: Agriculture and soil types, Kharif, Rabi, and Zaid cropping seasons, role of women in agriculture, modern and traditional farming techniques, sustainable irrigation and soil conservation.

hotspots.label: Bangladesh Border
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: India's longest land border (~4,096 km) traversing diverse rivers, forests, and terrain.

hotspots.label: Maritime SAGAR Vision
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Security and Growth for All in the Region: India's policy for Indian Ocean cooperation and Blue Economy.

hotspots.label: 1950 Indo-Nepal Treaty
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Establishes open borders permitting passport-free movement, residence, and employment for citizens.

video_overview.title: India & Her Neighbours
video_overview.topics_covered: Terrestrial land frontiers, maritime neighbours, 1950 Indo-Nepal Treaty, SAGAR policy and Blue Economy, Buddhist cultural corridors and HADR operations.

hotspots.label: Kannauj Tripartite Struggle
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Centuries-long conflict among Palas, Gurjara-Pratiharas, and Rashtrakutas for Gangetic hegemony.

hotspots.label: Kudavolai Ballot System
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Uttaramerur inscriptions describing palm-leaf pot-ticket voting for democratic village assemblies.

hotspots.label: Monolithic Kailashanatha Temple
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Top-down rock-cut excavation at Ellora Cave 16 built under Rashtrakuta King Krishna I.

video_overview.title: Empires & Kingdoms: 6th-10th C
video_overview.topics_covered: Harshavardhana and Kannauj, Chalukyas, Pallavas, and Rashtrakutas, Tripartite Struggle, Brahmadeya land grants and Samanta system, Sabha, Ur, and Kudavolai secret ballot system.

hotspots.label: Rajendra I Chola Naval Campaign
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: 1025 CE blue-water naval expedition across the Bay of Bengal to Srivijaya and Malacca Strait.

hotspots.label: Al-Biruni's Kitab al-Hind
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Comprehensive 11th-century Arabic Indology study covering Sanskrit math, astronomy, and philosophy.

hotspots.label: Battles of Tarain (1191 & 1192 CE)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Clashes between Prithviraj Chauhan and Muhammad Ghuri leading to the founding of the Delhi Sultanate.

video_overview.title: Turning Tides
video_overview.topics_covered: Ghaznavid raids and Ghurid conquests, First and Second Battles of Tarain, Al-Biruni's Kitab al-Hind, Chola naval expedition under Rajendra I, Bhaskaracharya II and Lilavati.

hotspots.label: Parsi Milk & Sugar Legend
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Arrival at Sanjan, Gujarat under King Jadi Rana; promising to sweeten Indian society without conflict.

hotspots.label: Siddi Community & Dhamal
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: East African heritage community preserving Siddi Dhamal dance; led by Padma Shri Hirabai Lobi.

hotspots.label: Cochin Paradesi Synagogue
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: 1568 Jewish heritage site in Kerala featuring Chinese willow porcelain tiles and Belgian glass chandeliers.

video_overview.title: India, a Home to Many
video_overview.topics_covered: Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam ethos, Parsi migration and Milk and Sugar legend, Cochin Jewish and Syriac Christian heritage, Siddi community and Siddi Dhamal dance, modern Indian global diaspora.

media_catalog.chapter_title: The State, the Government, and You

hotspots.label: Three Organs of Government
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Legislature (makes laws), Executive (enforces laws), and Judiciary (interprets laws and protects rights).

hotspots.label: Judiciary & Judicial Review
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Supreme Court power to strike down unconstitutional legislation violating Fundamental Rights.

hotspots.label: Four Elements of Statehood
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Defined Territory, Permanent Population, Functioning Government, and Sovereignty.

video_overview.title: State, Government, & You
video_overview.topics_covered: Four essential elements of a State, distinction between State and Government, Democratic Republic framework, Three Organs of Government, Separation of Powers and Judicial Review.

hotspots.label: Jingkieng Jri (Living Root Bridges)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Khasi and Jaintia tribe bio-engineering in Meghalaya using living roots of Ficus elastica trees.

hotspots.label: Four Infrastructure Pillars
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Transport (highways/rail), Energy (solar/wind), Water & Sanitation, and Digital Communications (5G/fiber).

hotspots.label: Atal Setu & Chenab Rail Bridge
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Atal Setu (~21.8 km sea bridge) and Chenab Rail Bridge (~359 m arch) exemplifying modern engineering.

video_overview.title: India's Infrastructure Engine
video_overview.topics_covered: Four pillars of physical infrastructure, transport, energy, water, and digital communications, Jingkieng Jri living root bridges, Cochin Solar Airport and renewable energy, civic asset protection.

media_catalog.chapter_title: Banks and the Magic of Finance

hotspots.label: Financial Intermediation
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Banks bridging surplus depositors and borrowers, earning operational profit through Interest Spread.

hotspots.label: UPI Digital Payments
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: NPCI real-time mobile QR payment system accounting for ~46% of global digital transaction volume.

hotspots.label: Power of Compound Interest
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Exponential wealth growth calculated on principal plus accumulated interest (Chessboard Wheat Legend).

video_overview.title: The Magic of Finance
video_overview.topics_covered: Financial intermediation and interest spread, commercial bank account types, Simple vs Compound interest dynamics, Chessboard wheat grain geometric doubling, Reserve Bank of India and UPI digital payments.
